metadata.title: Manus Tools Inventory
scope: Manus-related CLI utilities detected in the current Shell PATH
metadata.note: MCP tools dan Shell commands adalah dua antarmuka berbeda. File ini mencatat keduanya tanpa menganggap keduanya identik.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate images using AI based on prompts and visual references.

tools.name: generate_image_variation
tools.description: Edit or refine existing images using AI based on prompts.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Generate a video using AI based on prompts and visual references.

tools.name: generate_video_variation
tools.description: Edit or modify an existing video using AI based on a source video and prompt.

tools.name: generate_speech
tools.description: Generate speech audio from a prompt using AI.

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Generate music audio from a text prompt using AI.

tools.name: browser_click

tools.name: browser_scroll

tools.name: browser_move_mouse
tools.description: Move the cursor to a specified position on the browser page.

tools.description: Simulate a key press on the browser page.

tools.name: browser_select_option

tools.name: browser_save_image
tools.description: Save an image from the browser page to a local file.

tools.name: browser_upload_file

tools.name: browser_find_keyword

tools.name: browser_fill_form

tools.name: browser_console_view

tools.name: webdev_init_project
tools.description: Initialize a new web or mobile app project with scaffold, automated environment setup and hosting services.

tools.name: webdev_take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture preview screenshots of the active webdev project for visual verification.

tools.name: webdev_check_status
tools.description: Check the current status of the project development environment.

tools.name: webdev_restart_server
tools.description: Restart development services for the project.

tools.name: webdev_add_feature
tools.description: Add full-stack database/auth capabilities, Stripe payments, or Shopify headless storefronts to an existing WebDev project.

tools.name: webdev_request_secrets
tools.description: Add or update secrets/environment variables for the project.

tools.name: webdev_save_checkpoint
tools.description: Save a checkpoint of the current project state. Checkpoints are required before publishing.

tools.name: webdev_rollback_checkpoint
tools.description: Rollback project to a previous checkpoint state.

tools.name: webdev_execute_sql
tools.description: Execute a custom SQL query on the database.

tools.name: webdev_debug
tools.description: Request an independent debugging analysis from a specialized debugging agent.
